affinity.description: Affinity rules for the operator pod.

automountServiceAccountToken.description: Mount the ServiceAccount token. The operator talks to the API server, so it needs this; the value exists for policies that require it to be explicit.

extraArgs.description: Extra command line arguments for the operator.

extraEnv.description: Extra environment variables for the operator container.

fullnameOverride.description: Override the full resource name prefix.

digest.description: Image digest. Takes precedence over tag when set, for example `sha256:abc...`.

pullPolicy.description: Image pull policy. IfNotPresent is safe now that the default tag is the immutable appVersion rather than a floating latest.

tag.description: Image tag. Defaults to the chart appVersion, which pins each chart release to the operator build it was tested with.

imagePullSecrets.description: Image pull secrets for private registries.

leaderElect.description: Enable leader election so that only one replica reconciles at a time.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the metrics Service.

enabled.description: Expose the controller-runtime metrics endpoint through a Service.
Create a Prometheus Operator ServiceMonitor. Requires metrics.service.enabled and the monitoring.coreos.com CRDs.

labels.description: Extra labels for the ServiceMonitor, for Prometheus selector matching.

nameOverride.description: Override the chart name used in resource names.

cidr.description: CIDR containing the Kubernetes API server endpoint. Required when the policy is enabled.

except.description: CIDRs to exclude from the API server CIDR.

namespaceSelector.description: Namespace selector for the cluster DNS pods.

podSelector.description: Pod selector for the cluster DNS pods.

enabled.description: Create a NetworkPolicy for the operator pod. Requires an API server CIDR.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector for the operator pod.

podAnnotations.description: Annotations to add to the operator pod.

enabled.description: Create a PodDisruptionBudget. Only meaningful with replicaCount above 1, since leader election already keeps a single replica from being active twice.

maxUnavailable.description: Maximum unavailable pods. Mutually exclusive with minAvailable.

minAvailable.description: Minimum available pods. Mutually exclusive with maxUnavailable.

podLabels.description: Extra labels to add to the operator pod.

replicaCount.description: Number of operator replicas. Leader election makes only one of them active.

resources.description: Resource requests and limits for the operator container.

revisionHistoryLimit.description: How many old ReplicaSets to retain for the operator Deployment.

mode.description: Operator scope. `cluster` watches all namespaces via ClusterRole. `namespace` confines workload access to a single namespace via Role. CrashLoopPolicy itself is cluster-scoped either way, so policy access is always granted through a ClusterRole.

watchNamespace.description: Namespace to watch when mode is `namespace`. Defaults to the release namespace when empty.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the ServiceAccount.

create.description: Create a ServiceAccount for the operator.

name.description: Name of the ServiceAccount. Generated from the release name when empty.

topologySpreadConstraints.description: Topology spread constraints for the operator pod.
